# Metal: Hellsinger AP World v1.0.0 Initial Release for the Metal: Hellsinger AP World. - [Metal: Hellsinger AP World](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/ArchipelagoMetalHellsinger/releases/latest) - [Metal: Hellsinger Randomizer Mod](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/Metal-Hellsinger-AP-Mod/releases/latest) - [Setup Guide](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/ArchipelagoMetalHellsinger/blob/main/worlds/metal_hellsinger/docs/setup_en.md) ## What does randomization do to this game? In the Metal: Hellsinger Randomizer, every item in the game can be randomized. All Hells, Torments, Weapons, Songs, Outfits, Coat of Arms and Multiplier Pickups can be randomized, as well as player abilities like Jumping, Reloading, Dashing and destroying in-game destructibles.
Song and Outfit randomization and other options like additional weapon variants are also available and can be turned on in the client mod. ## What does this mod offer outside of the Archipelago Randomizer integration? This mod also includes customization in configuration, such as: - Enabling the hidden weapons from the Leviathan mode - Excluding Paz and or Terminus from Hells - Activating constant Weapon Trickery for all modes - Enabling Archdevil versions of torments/challenges - Randomizing outfits on Hells loading - Randomizing main and boss songs for the Hells mode, including a whitelist in randomization - Dispensing random items such as voicelines, multiplier pick ups or speed ups/downs during gameplay ## What is the goal of Metal: Hellsinger when randomized? The standard goal is the same as the vanilla game. Beat the Red Judge atop the mountain in Sheol. Alternatively, a number of Aspects can be slain instead. ## How many checks are in Metal: Hellsinger? There are between 150 and 500 checks located across the world of Metal: Hellsinger. ## Is there a tracker pack? There is currently no visual tracker pack for this randomizer. You can use the Universal Tracker (by Faris and qwint) to find a complete list of what checks are in logic with your current items. You can find it on the Archipelago Discord. This tracker is an extension of the regular Archipelago Text Client. ## What should I know regarding logic? In general: - You always start with one of the eight Hells. - You are expected to be able to beat any Hell if you do not randomize any ability. - In case of randomizing abilities, there are some soft requirements the logic abides to. For details check the Archipelago Discord thread ## Does this game have item and location groups? Yes! To find what they are, open up the Archipelago Text Client while connected to a Metal: Hellsinger session and type in `/item_groups` or `/location_groups`. ## Is there anything else I should know? - Death Link can be toggled in game, and it can be set to receive traps instead of deaths.

# Metal: Hellsinger AP World v1.1.0
Content Update for both the AP World _and_ the client.
**NOTE:** The client is not backward compatible with the previous version. Please make sure to update both

- [Metal: Hellsinger AP World](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/ArchipelagoMetalHellsinger/releases/latest)
- [Metal: Hellsinger Randomizer Mod](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/Metal-Hellsinger-AP-Mod/releases/latest)
- [Setup Guide](https://github.com/DanielSchaack/ArchipelagoMetalHellsinger/blob/main/worlds/metal_hellsinger/docs/setup_en.md)

## ADDED
- Mandatory "First Kill" checks for each enemy type and the bosses.
- Optional "First Slaughter" checks for each enemy type.
- Option for minimally required difficulty. Any difficulty below this one is not available and the client won't send any checks on lower difficulty. Logic respects this setting
- Option (and client configuration) to activate all enemies from Archdevil for any difficulty. Note: These enemies are added _on top_ of the regular ones, even in places where the enemies would be replaced for Archdevil

## CHANGED
- Fury Combo Checks are now optional
- Renamed Bestiary checks
- Cutscenes no longer count as play time, meaning no items/deathlinks can be received while they are active  
- Deathlink is no longer on by default 

## FIXED
- Game crashing when finishing a Hell while not being connected
- Sending Boon Checks when starting any Hell
- Sheol shows as locked if found but not having met its requirements
- Miscellaneous uncaught exception
- DLC Songs and Outfits not being randomized before connecting to any slot

## REMOVED
- Option for Non-randomized Hells. Please use Plando to add the required hells to inventory or to set them as completion rewards instead.
